name: open-policy-agent/opa
description: Open Policy Agent (OPA) is a CNCF graduated open-source general-purpose policy engine enabling unified, context-aware policy enforcement across infrastructure, microservices, and applications using the Rego policy language.
score_rationale: CNCF graduated project and de facto policy-as-code standard with 11.4k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, used by major enterprises for unified policy enforcement.
